vetSays.line: 🛡️ Fulvio, Ines, Greta, Ava and Sari met them at the door — 5 put down. Fulvio, Ines, Greta, Ava, Sari are hurt.
🛡️ Niamh, Colleen and Reagan met them at the door — 3 put down. Niamh, Colleen, Reagan are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fulvio just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Niamh, Colleen, Fulvio and Ines met them at the door — 4 put down. Colleen, Ines are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Niamh just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Jorge met them at the door — 1 put down. Jorge is hurt.
🛡️ Niamh, Sari, Devon and David met them at the door — 4 put down. Niamh, Sari, Devon, David are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ava just put down The Suburb... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Dewa met them at the door — 1 put down. Dewa is hurt.
🛡️ Francisco, Saúl and Paul met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Saúl didn't come back. Francisco, Paul are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Francisco just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Francisco and Paul met them at the door — 1 put down. Paul didn't come back.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Bahadir just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

regDeaths.name: a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
something heavy rooting in the grass, dust rising for no reason
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
a toad like a war drum, throat swelling
a soft green glow under the water
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
